purpose: Show a finance or accounting lead what the package takes off their team, what’s in it, how their data stays safe, and get them to start an AI check-up.

seo.title: AI for finance and accounting | Alliance AI Partners
seo.description: Invoice processing, bookkeeping help, expense checks and monthly reports, built and run by an embedded AI team in the Philippines. Every finance project starts with a privacy and compliance review.

content.heading: Clean books, without the typing.
content.lead: AI reads your invoices, checks expenses and drafts the monthly report. Your team stays in charge of what goes in the books.
body: Every finance and accounting project starts with a privacy and compliance review.

images.source: Editorial illustration on a Daylight background, nearly square (about 1:1), safe to crop to 4:5 around the centre. A calm field seen from slightly above, laid out in long, perfectly even rows of small flat faceted paper plants in Partner Navy, slate blue and pale blue, like the lines of a tidy ledger. A smooth satin ribbon stream in a gradient from Alliance Blue to Ribbon Cyan flows in from the upper left and runs along the head of the field, feeding every row in turn: books kept in order without the typing. Generous calm Daylight space in the top third. Palette only: Partner Navy #121B2A, Alliance Blue #1B56FF, Ribbon Cyan #00D5FF, Daylight #F4F7FB and the shades between them. Nature built from satin ribbon and flat paper facets. Light from the upper left, soft navy-tinted shadows falling down and to the right. No text or letters, no people, no hands, no robots, no brains, no circuit boards, no sparkles, no glow, no purple or pink, no regional or cultural motifs, no real places or landmarks.
images.placement: right half of the hero split (1.08fr text | 1fr image); on mobile under the actions, above the meta line
images.textArea: none (text sits beside the image); keep the top third calm
images.alt: A ribbon stream runs along even rows of faceted paper plants.

sections.name: Section · Slow work
sections.job: Show we understand the slow, manual work in this industry before offering a fix (Brand DNA: listen first).
sections.desktop: Split: head column 520 (Heading/2 title, Body/LG lead) | four hairline rows on the right (Heading/4 title 300 | Body/Default text).
sections.mobile: Head, then the four rows stacked (title above text) between hairlines.

content.heading: The work that fills month end.
content.lead: Much of it is copying numbers from one place to another, then checking that they match.

items.title: Typing in invoices
items.text: Supplier invoices arrive as PDFs and photos, and someone keys each one into the books.

items.title: Matching payments
items.text: Bank lines are matched to invoices by hand, one at a time.

items.title: Checking expenses
items.text: Receipts get chased, and each claim is checked against your policy by hand.

items.title: Building the monthly report
items.text: Figures are pulled from several systems into one spreadsheet, then formatted again every month.

sections.note: Descriptions of common manual work, written as the problem; no figures, no claims about how long anything takes.

sections.name: Section · Package
sections.job: Name the ready-made package for this industry exactly as the Brand DNA lists it, with what each part does.
sections.desktop: Section head (anchor #package). Bento: one large card 648 (image slot 648x340 at the top, Heading/3 title and Body/Default text) beside a column of smaller cards, one per remaining package item (service icon 40 | Heading/4 title and Body/SM text). Both columns end at the same height.
sections.mobile: Head stacked; the large card first with the image re-cropped to 16:10 (358x224), then the item cards (icon 32).

content.heading: The finance and accounting package.
content.lead: Four popular AI services, packaged for finance and accounting teams. Start with one and add more over time.

items.title: Invoice processing
items.text: AI reads each invoice, pulls out the supplier, dates, amounts and tax, and puts them where they belong in your books. Anything unusual goes to a person.

items.title: Bookkeeping help
items.text: Bank lines matched to invoices and entries drafted, ready for your bookkeeper to approve.

items.title: Expense checks
items.text: Receipts read and each claim checked against your policy, with anything unusual flagged for review.

items.title: Monthly reports
items.text: Your figures pulled into your usual report each month, with a plain-English summary for you to check.

images.slotName: IMG-21-2 · A leaf read into its places
images.source: Editorial illustration on a Daylight background, wide (about 2:1), safe to crop to 16:10 around the centre. At the left, one large flat faceted paper leaf lies on a calm surface, its veins traced in fine Alliance Blue lines. From the veins, four thin satin ribbons in a gradient from Alliance Blue to Ribbon Cyan lift and run to the right, each settling into its own small faceted paper seed pod in a neat row: each detail read from the leaf and put where it belongs, the way an invoice is read and filed. Keep the top third calm and plain. Palette only: Partner Navy #121B2A, Alliance Blue #1B56FF, Ribbon Cyan #00D5FF, Daylight #F4F7FB and the shades between them. Nature built from satin ribbon and flat paper facets. Light from the upper left, soft navy-tinted shadows falling down and to the right. No text or letters, no people, no hands, no robots, no brains, no circuit boards, no sparkles, no glow, no purple or pink, no regional or cultural motifs, no real places or landmarks.
images.placement: top of the large bento card, full bleed inside the card (radius 0, the card clips it); same on mobile
images.textArea: none (text sits below the image in the card); keep the top third calm
images.alt: Ribbon threads lift from a leaf’s veins into a neat row of seed pods.

Steps where a person decides carry a 10% Ribbon Cyan tint.
sections.mobile: Title, lead, the panel full width (each step: number | text with its Tag below), then the link.

content.heading: AI does the typing. Your team decides.
content.lead: A sample of how one supplier invoice moves through the package. We map your real steps with your team before we build.

items.text: The invoice arrives by email as a PDF.
AI reads the supplier, dates, amounts and tax.
AI matches it to the purchase order.
An amount that doesn’t match is flagged.
Your accounts team checks the flag and approves.
The entry is posted to your books.

images.source: UI composition drawn in Figma (not a raster): a Partner 30 panel with a "Sample" tag, the title "One supplier invoice", and the numbered steps above, each tagged with who does it.
images.alt: Sample: One supplier invoice, step by step.

sections.note: A sample, labelled as one; no times, volumes or results.

sections.name: Section · Services
sections.job: List the services that work alongside the package, with published starting prices where they exist and a fixed quote otherwise.
sections.desktop: Section head, then six Service rows in two columns of three (title, Brand DNA one-liner, price in mono, arrow), then a link to every service.
sections.mobile: Head; the six Service rows (Mobile variant) in one column; link.

content.heading: Add more when you’re ready.
content.lead: These services work well alongside the finance and accounting package. You get a fixed quote before any work starts.

items.title: AI automation
items.text: One slow process handled by AI and checked by a person.

items.title: Document processing
items.text: We pull the data out of invoices, contracts, forms and receipts and put it where it belongs.

items.title: Fraud and anomaly detection
items.text: Unusual payments or logins get flagged as they happen.

items.title: Talk to your data
items.text: Ask questions in plain English and get charts and answers back.

items.title: Knowledge assistants
items.text: An assistant that answers staff questions using your company’s own documents.

items.title: Embedded developers
items.text: A developer from our team works inside yours, full time.

sections.note: Only the launch services carry a starting price ([PRICE]); every other row says "Fixed quote", which is the Brand DNA pricing promise (a fixed quote before work starts).

sections.name: Section · Data
sections.job: Say how the partner’s data stays safe, in Brand DNA promises only, with the one sourced legal fact.
sections.desktop: Whole Partner Navy chapter. Section head (Heading/1 title with the cyan accent 0.9fr | Body/LG lead 1.1fr). A 2x2 grid of promises between hairlines: cyan UI icon (24) | Heading/4 title (the law item carries Source key 1) and Body/Default text. Cyan underlined link, then the numbered source list.
sections.mobile: Head stacked; the four promises as one column of hairline rows (icon | title and text); link; source list.

content.heading: Your numbers stay yours.
content.lead: Every finance and accounting project starts with a privacy and compliance review, because financial data has stricter rules.

items.title: Your data stays where you decide
items.text: In your own systems wherever possible. We never use it to train anything you don’t own.

items.title: A person checks the work
items.text: A person reviews every piece of work before it reaches you, and anything unusual waits for your team.

items.title: An owner and a backup plan
items.text: Every automation has both, written down clearly enough for a new hire to follow.

items.title: Protected by law
items.text: Personal data in the Philippines is protected by the Data Privacy Act of 2012, enforced by an independent National Privacy Commission.

sources.text: Republic Act No. 10173, Data Privacy Act of 2012. Supreme Court E-Library. Retrieved 2026-11-02.

content.heading: Find what’s worth automating first.
content.lead: The AI check-up is our usual first project. We learn how your finance team works, find where AI could save you time or money, and hand you a written plan with a fixed quote for the first fix.

items.title: From [PRICE]
items.text: The whole check-up, at a fixed price

items.title: [two weeks]
items.text: From the first call to your written plan

notes: Built from the shared industry template, so pages 21 to 24 read as a set; each has its own hero image and package image. Package items are the Brand DNA finance and accounting list (invoice processing, bookkeeping help, expense checks, monthly reports). The hero meta and the data lead state the Brand DNA rule that finance projects start with a privacy and compliance review. The sample is labelled as a sample and carries no amounts, times or results. Header marks Services as current. One Primary in the hero and one in the closing card, never in one screenful. The only figure-like fact (the Data Privacy Act of 2012) carries Source key 1 and a dated source line in its own section.
